meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 根据技能，Claude 会在本地启动一个网页仪表盘，以图形方式展示当前项目的知识图谱；如果项目还没有生成知识图谱文件，会提示先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当用户明确调用该技能（例如提出“看项目知识图谱”或“启动仪表盘”），可附带项目路径；未附路径时使用当前目录。

say.text: 启动当前项目的知识图谱仪表盘
say.note: 将在浏览器中打开带访问令牌的仪表盘。

say.text: 为 <项目路径> 启动仪表盘
say.note: 将用该项目已生成的知识图谱文件启动。

say.text: 打开仪表盘，看看这个代码库的关系图
say.note: 若缺少图谱文件，会提醒先运行 /understand。

howto.what_en: This skill starts a local web dashboard that renders the project's knowledge graph as an interactive visual map. If the graph file is missing, it tells the user to run /understand first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to launch the dashboard, e.g. requests to view the project's knowledge graph or start the dashboard; it accepts a project path and falls back to the current directory.

say_en.text: Launch the knowledge graph dashboard for the current project.
say_en.note: Opens the dashboard with a tokenized URL.
Uses the knowledge graph of that project.

say_en.text: Open the dashboard to see this codebase's relationship graph.
say_en.note: Prompts you to run /understand if no graph exists.
